newsitem.title: CHINA: Earthquake shakes China's remote Tibet region.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake shakes China's remote Tibet region.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.4 on the open-ended Richter scale shook a remote corner of Tibet on Saturday, officials said on Sunday.
There were no reports of casualties or property damage in the mountainous and sparsely populated region, officials of the State Seismological Bureau told Reuters.
The quake was centred in Gaize, about 720 km (430 miles) northwest of the regional capital of Lhasa.
